title: Part 3 — Organizational Hierarchy Verification
description: Validates 8-tier organizational structure, reporting relationships, authority escalation, cycle prevention, and orphan recovery.

assertions.name: assert_8_tier_hierarchy_coverage
assertions.message: 8-tier enterprise digital workforce hierarchy validated (CEO -> Exec -> Mgr -> Lead -> Specialist -> Worker -> Reviewer -> Auditor)

assertions.name: assert_authority_escalation_paths
assertions.message: Deterministic escalation routing propagated high-risk exceptions up the formal chain of command

assertions.name: assert_circular_reporting_prevention
assertions.message: Organizational topology verifier confirmed acyclic hierarchy with 0 circular supervisor loops

assertions.name: assert_orphan_agent_recovery
assertions.message: Autonomous supervisor failover dynamically re-parented orphaned workers to parent department managers
